message: No detected input validation: The inference function accepts raw image data from Gradio and converts it directly without any type, shape, or range validation on the incoming array.
No detected untrusted source handling: The model is loaded from a local file path with no checksum verification, signature validation, or integrity check of any kind.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is performed anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads model weights via torch.load() and load_state_dict() without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; it simply loads from a file path with no integrity guarantees.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer used is plain SGD with no differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While separate train/validation/test splits exist in TDContainer, there is no cryptographic signing or hashing of evaluation data, and the test set is not verifiably isolated from training influence; only a single accuracy metric is reported.
No detected input sanitization: The inference function directly converts the incoming numpy array to a PIL Image and applies transforms without any shape, type, range, or size validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: The softmax output is directly returned as a dict without any NaN guards, probability sum checks, or confidence threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision image classification model, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
